llm.summary: The skill's requests and runtime instructions align with its stated customer-support persona: it delegates Gmail/Sheets/Chat/Calendar work to a gws tool and related utility skills and does not request unrelated credentials or intrusive installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (customer support: triage email, log tickets, escalate, schedule) match the declared runtime requirements: the SKILL.md calls the 'gws' binary and utility skills for Gmail, Sheets, Chat, and Calendar — all reasonable for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are narrowly scoped to triaging Gmail, converting emails to tasks, appending rows to Sheets, sending chat escalations, and inserting calendar events via 'gws' workflows. They do not instruct reading unrelated files, broad system interrogation, or exfiltration to unknown endpoints. They do assume the listed utility skills are available.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — lowest-risk delivery mechanism. It only requires a 'gws' binary to be present on PATH; nothing is downloaded or written by the skill itself.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill itself declares no environment variables or credentials, which is consistent. However it depends on other 'gws-*' utility skills and the 'gws' binary; those dependencies will likely need Google Workspace credentials and OAuth scopes (Gmail/Sheets/Chat/Calendar). Review those dependent skills' requested scopes/credentials before enabling in a production account.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default). The skill does not request persistent platform-wide privileges or modifications to other skills' configurations.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent for customer-support automation: it expects a 'gws' CLI and helper skills for Gmail/Sheets/Chat/Calendar and itself is instruction-only. Before installing, verify the origin/trustworthiness of the 'gws' binary and the 'gws-*' utility skills (they'll likely require Google OAuth scopes). Specifically: 1) Confirm who provides the 'gws' binary and install source; don't run an untrusted binary. 2) Inspect the 'gws-gmail', 'gws-sheets', 'gws-chat', and 'gws-calendar' skills to see exactly which Google scopes/credentials they request and whether those scopes are appropriate. 3) Test with a limited/test Google account or least-privilege credentials first. 4) Note the SKILL.md references workflows and chat escalation destinations but doesn't hardcode destinations — decide and configure safe destination channels before granting access.
